quality_criteria.QA1: C_OFF has 0 ARM-LOCAL wrist reversal flicks in steps 171->172 .. 199->200 (W131 definition)
quality_criteria.QA2: continuity: C_OFF arm-local entry/exit C0 steps each <= 2 x B's + 10 mm AND max(entry, exit) < C_ON's AND arm-local RMS jerk < C_ON's
quality_criteria.QA3: C_OFF has no near-straight (>175 deg) interior frame, no bend-direction flip, no hinge-opposite frame
quality_criteria.QA4: source fidelity: C_OFF mean interior WORLD wrist deviation from A < B's AND < C_ON's
quality_criteria.QA5: press intent (W131 rule): wrist-above-shoulder never dips > 50 mm below the lower endpoint value (171/200)
quality_criteria.QA6: blinded agent review: C_OFF most natural (V2), not named for a flick (V1) or a wrong elbow (V3), not least faithful and ranked above BOTH B and C_ON (V4), read as an upward press (V6)

candidate.rule: only if replay, flag isolation, leak and the R1 context gate pass: R1 interior samples 114..132 projected with the UNCHANGED W131 projection (W129 B twist reference, 20->30 slerp, no filtering) -> C_OFF separate .blend from the frozen baseline and C_OFF composed on the W126V-accepted .blend; fresh-process readbacks; footprint/pin gates as W131 G4/G5; A / B / C_ON (frozen W131 C .blend) / C_OFF on the same rig, renders, crop and 30-fps grid
candidate.visual_protocol: panels W/X/Y/Z = random permutation of A/B/C_ON/C_OFF sealed in blind_key_SEALED.json; the agent answers from blinded stills before reading the key; AGENT-ONLY; human native-rate review NOT RUN. Disclosed weakness: the agent knows the W131 C_ON appearance (teleport at 171/172) and the R1 model-space numbers before review

visual_questions.V1: Which panel(s) show a visible unnatural one-frame flick/teleport/reversal of the left arm (Action 171-201)?
visual_questions.V2: Which panel's left-arm motion through the interior looks most natural and temporally coherent?
visual_questions.V3: Which panel(s) show an anatomically wrong elbow (hyperextension, flip) or limb-length artefact?
visual_questions.V4: Rank the four panels most -> least by agreement with the source video's visible left-arm pose and timing (rack -> press).
visual_questions.V5: Is any boundary discontinuity visible at 171/172 or 199/200 in any panel?
visual_questions.V6: For each panel: does the interior read as an upward overhead press (yes) or as a swing / detour / hold / other (no)?

case_rule.A: all gates pass AND QA1-QA6 pass (narrowly supported; supports only a follow-up human decision, never promotion)
case_rule.B: authentic paired runs and (when built) a safe comparison, but any QA1-QA6 fails: mechanism evidence, quality negative
case_rule.C: real inference ran but R1 fails the observed-context gate, the projection is unsafe/refused, or a C_OFF Action/pin/clock/video gate fails: no candidate acceptance
case_rule.D: integrity falsified: W131 R0 exact replay mismatch (either runner), ON/OFF flag-isolation check fails (OFF changes anything but the diffusion-step replacement), the R1 masked-input leak control is not bitwise equal, a negative control does not fail closed, or a declaration/instrument hash changed
case_rule.DATA_BLOCKED: a required authentic prerequisite (rights, exact W131 checkpoint/artifacts, S1 source/baseline/rig, W126/W129 inputs, runtime, Blender) is absent or mismatched before the S1 causal pair

conditions.R0: W132 instrumented runner, impute=True: must be bitwise equal to frozen W131 model_R1 (instrumentation non-invasive)
conditions.R0_w131code: UNCHANGED W131 runner (impute=True), frozen W131 conditioning.npz: exact replay; output must be bitwise equal to frozen W131 model_R1
conditions.R1: W132 instrumented runner, impute=False; every other input, flag, seed and tensor identical
conditions.R1_leak: R1 with the frozen W131 conditioning_leak.npz (UNKNOWN rig channels rotated, seed 131) AND every masked input feature replaced by seeded noise (seed 131): output must be bitwise equal to R1
conditions.determinism_rerun: not planned (R0 replays a cross-session result; R1_leak doubles as an R1 rerun); run only if needed, labelled
conditions.negative_controls: runner refuses a mismatched input / reference SHA-256 (no model load); Blender stage refuses a channel outside the edit domain and a frame outside 172..199; declaration/instrument tamper refused (unit test)

config.sampler: official CondMDIPipeline._sample -> p_sample_loop -> p_sample -> p_mean_variance (ancestral over the ddim100 respaced schedule)
config.text: a person stands in place and presses both arms straight up overhead

context_gate.arm_window: left elbow/wrist ric error at observed samples 103..113 and 133..143 <= 0.05 m
context_gate.consequence: FAIL -> R1 cannot be accepted as an edit: no candidate projection (CASE C)
context_gate.observed_mean: mean ric error over every observed joint-sample <= 0.05 m

flag_isolation.rule: ON/OFF pass only if: identical input/absolute/mask/effective-conditioning arrays; identical seed/text/length/guidance/respacing; equal network-call count (= 2 x steps, CFG); one identical obs_x0 and obs_mask hash on every call of both runs; identical text tokens; y option keys differ exactly by {imputate, stop_imputation_at, replacement_distribution, inpainted_motion, inpainting_mask}; requires_imputation True on every step (ON) / False on every step (OFF); reconstruction guidance never; first-step network inputs and outputs identical; first divergence at or after network call 2

mechanism_rule.OFF_CONTINUOUS_ONLY_BY_DEPARTING_FROM_CO: else, if the R1 context gate fails or max(R1 effective) > 0.5 x max(R0 effective)
mechanism_rule.PERSISTS_UNDER_LEARNED_CONDITIONING: max(R1 internal entry, exit) > 0.5 x max(R0 effective entry, exit)
mechanism_rule.REPLACEMENT_IMPUTATION_PRIMARY_SUPPORTED: otherwise (R1 continuous AND consistent with the observed context)
mechanism_rule.inputs: left-wrist model-space ric (root-relative heading-frame) positions; R0 = impute ON (= W131 R1), R1 = impute OFF; effective entry = |out[114] - observed[113]|, effective exit = |observed[133] - out[132]|, internal = same with out[113]/out[133]
mechanism_rule.limits: one source, one seed, one text: does not separately identify proxy torso, source jitter, text semantics or training coverage

reference_control.caption: a person walks forward and waves with the right hand
reference_control.limits: MODEL-GENERATED CLOSED-LOOP SYNTHETIC: neither held-out data nor proof of on-distribution generalisation; not real-video quality evidence; no fifth cell
reference_control.metrics: per cell vs the reference (as conditioned: relative_to_absolute of the frozen relative tensor): hidden MPJPE (ric/world), endpoint MPJPE at the first/last hidden sample, boundary excess = max over joints of (out step - reference step) at 49->50 and 68->69, observed-feature residual by group, observed-frame MPJPE
reference_control.origin: W131 independent smoke: CondMDI text-to-motion (no observation), model-card caption, seed 42, CFG 2.5, ddim100, 120 samples
reference_control.readings: a cell has a boundary discontinuity if its ric boundary excess > 50.0 mm; replacement effect = (i vs iii), (ii vs iv); feature-group effect = (i vs ii), (iii vs iv); descriptive only
reference_control.root_semantics: official grouping, identical joints/frames in every cell: pelvis pos = root xz + height (observed in all four cells), pelvis rot = root yaw (observed only in pos_rot_vel cells), pelvis vel (pos_rot_vel only); the four foot-contact features are observed in ALL cells (official joint_mask_to_feature_mask always adds them); all values are the reference's own complete model-generated features (nothing synthetic is added)
reference_control.seed_reason: seed 42 is the noise that generated the reference itself (degenerate closed loop); 7 is the pre-existing W131 smoke mask-contract seed

time_map.reconstruction: frame f <- model position s=2(f-1)/3: exact sample when integral, else slerp of the per-sample left-arm basis between samples floor(s), floor(s)+1 (weights 1/3, 2/3); only Action 172..199 (s=114..132) are written; Action 240 (s=159.33) is beyond the last sample and never reconstructed
time_map.rule: Action frame f at t=(f-1)/30 s on [0, 8.0); model sample k at t=k/20 s; 240 frames <-> 160 samples; even k = exact frame 1+1.5k; odd k = half-frame, every keyed channel SO(3)-slerped at 0.5 (INTERPOLATED hypothesis)
